blocks.text: Globe is calling for telecommunications restoration to be made a national priority alongside power and other essential utilities during disasters, through a proposed National Utility Resiliency Plan that would address barriers that delay the return of critical services. The framework would set clear protocols for government agencies, local government units, utilities, and telecommunications operators to work together and help communities regain essential services faster. Globe raised the proposal during the GSMA Policy Principles for Mobile Network Resilience discussion recently held in New Delhi, India.
